scripts.dev: uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.start: uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.check: uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python -m compileall app
